integrations.#Map: This is a map. Key = integration endpoint path, Value = integration configuration object

openintegration/v1.0/integration/<Name o.externalDsl: #Required. External DSL file name from integration-configurations/<Domain>/external-dsl/. Example: DBE-To-Siebel-Contact-Publish.json

externalREST.describe: #Describe endpoint path in external system. Example: /tmf632/describe
externalREST.openAPIFilepath: #OpenAPI spec file name from integration-configurations/<Domain>/restoutbound/. Example: tm632.json

inboundEventRegistration.topic: #Inbound topic to subscribe for this integration. This also be defined as Event Store in EPS settings in config.json eps.aieventconfig.ConfigParam settings Example: OSM-Orders-Produce
partitions: #Optional partition numbers to subscribe from. Example: 0
inboundEventRegistration.integrationUser: #Required integration user to run callback execution for this inbound event. Example: sadmin

externalREST.#Map: This is a map. Key = unique system alias used in DSL RESTOutbound.restSpec, Value = external REST configuration object

#Unique System Name.baseURL: #Base URL of external REST system. Example: https://example.com

authentication.#Mandatory: Required. Configure exactly one authentication mode: either 'basic' or 'oidc-client-credentials'

oidc-client-credentials.oidc-flow: #Optional OIDC flow. Example: client-credentials or user-assertion
oidc-client-credentials.scope: #OAuth scope required by the external API

outboundEvents.#Map: This is a map. Key = outbound event alias used in DSL EventPublish.queue, Value = outbound event configuration object

#Unique Name of the Queue.topic: #Outbound topic name used for publishing events to Kafka
